fixes.description: Preview and finalization now run identical complete record metadata validation and temporary report staging, with baseline, projection metadata, and completion-event gates rechecked before any publication. Preview creates no completion timestamp or live output/event.

Resolved inventory rows reject unsupported fields and mismatching page scan identities. Audit patches reject unknown fields and identity changes; an idempotent same-identity patch remains accepted. Additions must satisfy the same complete row schema.

Begin/finalize/recovery require all106 mapped page/record identities and exact recursive file sets, matching page hashes, first-pass inventory confirmation and ordered done events. Completed prior audits require matching record/session/log evidence and coherent timestamps. The selected active or pending session alone receives explicit interrupted-start/commit recovery handling.

Freeze errors carry observed preparation and commit state. written, write_attempted, prepared, committed, manifest_created/reused and hash_block_appended distinguish partial writes from a committed marker, including errors after publication/append.

New manifests persist a versioned full state fingerprint over page/record/session/history/combined bytes and recognized completion/audit event lines. Read-only and writing retries reject changed or missing pins. Added freeze hash blocks do not change the fingerprint; committed legacy schema1 verification remains supported.
Freeze parsing now matches audit parsing for malformed event-looking lines and duplicate identity fields; both are rejected before readiness/fingerprinting.

validation.fixtures: Invented106-page trees under temporary work/helper_hardening_fixtures directories; explicit temporary output/map arguments for every audit/freeze call.
validation.independent_review: Code-only review identified a started-session recovery interruption; resume now persists commit_pending/completed_utc before publication, and a two-interruption regression test passes.
validation.revision_scope: Initial28-test full run before the narrow parser follow-up; retained as historical evidence.

compatibility: resume_audit retains its first two positional arguments and adds optional witnesses; --resume now honors --witness-root for the complete event gate.
Same-identity inventory patches remain valid; unknown fields and different identities are rejected.
Committed schema1 freezes without a fingerprint remain verifiable; uncommitted legacy manifests lacking a pin are preserved and refused rather than silently adopted.

bounded_scan083_qa.scope: Bounded metadata and syntax; no witness/source prose files or image files opened. Crop geometry and safe paths checked without image dimensions. Source-C edit replay and pixel-extent bounds were not repeated in this restricted pass.

coverage: Malformed event appended after interrupted preparation is rejected by readiness and writing retry without writes.
Duplicate identity fields are rejected by parsing itself and retry without writes.
Unchanged retry preserves the manifest and verifies107 synthetic files.
